instruction:
You are a civil/coastal engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-04 wave runup, freeboard, and asset protection package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External linear-wave, shoaling, breaking, runup, freeboard, and armor-sizing workflows shape the practice context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-04-LH-02`
- Wave climate table: `WAVE-04-CLIMATE-02`
- Shore profile: `PROFILE-04-SHORE-02`
- Asset level table: `ASSET-04-LEVEL-02`
- Armor/barrier schedule: `ARMOR-04-SCHED-02`
- Design horizon criterion: `CRIT-04-HORIZON-02`
- Asset protection memo: `MEMO-04-PROTECT-02`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Offshore wave height | {{ offshore_wave_height_m }} m |
| Wave period | {{ wave_period_s }} s |
| Shoaling coefficient | {{ shoaling_coefficient }} |
| Nearshore depth | {{ nearshore_depth_m }} m |
| Breaker index | {{ breaker_index }} |
| Runup coefficient | {{ runup_coefficient }} |
| Slope factor | {{ slope_factor }} |
| Stillwater level | {{ stillwater_level_m }} m |
| Asset platform level | {{ asset_platform_level_m }} m |
| Required freeboard | {{ required_freeboard_m }} m |
| Selected armor mass | {{ selected_armor_mass_t }} t |
| Required armor mass | {{ required_armor_mass_t }} t |

## Checks

- Deepwater wavelength equals `9.81 x wave_period_s^2 / (2 x pi)`.
- Nearshore wave height equals offshore wave height times the source-owned shoaling coefficient.
- Breaking height limit equals breaker index times nearshore depth.
- Runup equals runup coefficient times nearshore wave height times slope factor.
- Total water level equals stillwater level plus runup.
- Freeboard margin equals asset platform level minus total water level and required freeboard.
- Armor stability margin equals selected armor mass minus required armor mass.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when the wave height stays below the breaking limit and the freeboard and armor margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact asset protection memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "deepwater_wavelength_m": <numeric_value>,
  "shoaling_coefficient": <numeric_value>,
  "nearshore_wave_height_m": <numeric_value>,
  "breaking_height_limit_m": <numeric_value>,
  "breaking_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "runup_2_percent_m": <numeric_value>,
  "total_water_level_m": <numeric_value>,
  "freeboard_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "armor_stability_margin_t": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "wave-runup-freeboard-asset-protection-package"
description = "SSC-04 wave runup, freeboard, and asset protection metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound coastal wave protection metrics from a deterministic SSC-04 task-owned source pack. The template combines wave transform, breaking height, runup, total water level, freeboard, armor stability margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "coastal-wave-protection"
standards = ["linear wave workflow", "wave runup workflow", "freeboard review", "armor protection review"]
tags = ["civil", "coastal", "wave", "runup", "freeboard", "armor", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.offshore_wave_height_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "WAVE-04-CLIMATE-02 offshore wave height"
min = 1.8
max = 1.8

[params.wave_period_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "WAVE-04-CLIMATE-02 wave period"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.shoaling_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "PROFILE-04-SHORE-02 source-owned shoaling coefficient"
min = 1.12
max = 1.12

[params.nearshore_depth_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PROFILE-04-SHORE-02 nearshore depth"
min = 3.2
max = 3.2

[params.breaker_index]
type = "float"
description = "CRIT-04-HORIZON-02 breaker index"
min = 0.78
max = 0.78

[params.runup_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "CRIT-04-HORIZON-02 runup coefficient"
min = 1.6
max = 1.6

[params.slope_factor]
type = "float"
description = "PROFILE-04-SHORE-02 slope factor"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.stillwater_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-04-HORIZON-02 stillwater level"
min = 2.05
max = 2.05

[params.asset_platform_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "ASSET-04-LEVEL-02 asset platform level"
min = 5.1
max = 5.1

[params.required_freeboard_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-04-HORIZON-02 required freeboard"
min = 0.3
max = 0.3

[params.selected_armor_mass_t]
type = "float"
unit = "t"
description = "ARMOR-04-SCHED-02 selected armor mass"
min = 3.5
max = 3.5

[params.required_armor_mass_t]
type = "float"
unit = "t"
description = "ARMOR-04-SCHED-02 required armor mass"
min = 2.8
max = 2.8

[outputs.deepwater_wavelength_m]
description = "Deepwater wavelength from wave period"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.shoaling_coefficient]
description = "Source-owned shoaling coefficient"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.nearshore_wave_height_m]
description = "Offshore wave height times shoaling coefficient"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.breaking_height_limit_m]
description = "Breaker index times nearshore depth"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.breaking_margin_m]
description = "Breaking height limit minus nearshore wave height"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.runup_2_percent_m]
description = "Two-percent runup estimate"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_water_level_m]
description = "Stillwater level plus runup"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.freeboard_margin_m]
description = "Asset level minus total water level and required freeboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.armor_stability_margin_t]
description = "Selected armor mass minus required armor mass"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when breaking, freeboard, and armor checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
